urn:eigenius:core:description: An Eigenius notebook — an ordered sequence of Cell resources with metadata. Notebook IRIs are content-addressed (sha-256 over the canonical structural form): identical content yields an identical IRI.

A single cell of a notebook. Cell IRIs are content-addressed (sha-256 over the cell's structural form), so identical cells across notebooks share a single resource. Source-bearing cells (markdown/esl/eigenql/typescript) carry a `source` string; program-run cells carry `program_iri` + `input_iris`; formalize cells carry PROSE in `source` plus `doc_id` (+ optional `structure_iri` / `lexicon_profile` / `land`); chart cells carry `chart_query` + `chart_kind` + `chart_x_column` + `chart_y_column` (+ optional `chart_series_column` / `chart_title`).
The type of a notebook Cell. The instances (markdown, esl, eigenql, typescript, program-run, chart) form the closed set permitted by the cell_type property's allows_only constraint.
Notebook file format version (currently 1). Bumped on breaking changes to the notebook structure.
Human-readable notebook title. Queryable for search/index UIs.
Short description of what the notebook does. Queryable for search/index UIs.
ISO 8601 creation timestamp. Excluded from the content-addressed Notebook IRI hash so that re-saving identical content does not change identity.
ISO 8601 last-modified timestamp. Excluded from the content-addressed Notebook IRI hash.
Eigenius platform version when the notebook was last saved. Excluded from the content-addressed Notebook IRI hash.
Ordered list of Cell resources composing the notebook. Order is preserved by array position.

The type of this Cell — one of the CellType resources. Restricted by allows_only to ensure new cell types require an explicit ontology update (and, because this file is in BOOTSTRAP_CHAIN, a reseed — which is the cost that keeps the enumeration honest).
Source text of the cell. The cell's content-addressed IRI hashes (cell_type, source) — so changing the source mints a new Cell resource.
Markdown render-only cell. Renders as Github-flavoured Markdown; does not execute.
ESL declaration / program cell. Run via eigen.load() — the kernel compiles ESL and commits a new layer.
EigenQL query cell. Run via eigen.query() against the active layer chain; output renders in a Fluent DataGrid.
TypeScript orchestration cell. Executes in the browser sandbox with the SDK in scope (Phase 4).
Program-run cell. Invokes a program (program_iri) against one or more inputs (input_iris) via runProgramByIri; renders typed output + trace tree per input.

Formalization cell (D71). Its `source` is PROSE, not code: the cell runs FormalizeDocument over it and renders the per-unit outcome table, the claims, the DecisionPoints with their runners-up, the AnaphorBindings, and the CutItem/LexicalGap stream. `doc_id` names the run's doc-<id> working branch, which holds the document glossary and the run's recorded LLM draws — re-running the cell replays those instead of re-asking the model. `structure_iri` is the enc:ReasoningStructure the last run produced; the artifact itself is NOT committed by the cell (D71 §4 keeps generation decoupled from commitment), so landing it is an explicit load.

Chart cell (Phase 5d). Form-based: runs an EigenQL query (chart_query) and renders the ResultSet as a Fluent chart of the configured kind (chart_kind) using chart_x_column / chart_y_column (and optional chart_series_column) to pivot rows.
IRI of the program a program-run cell invokes.
Ordered list of input IRIs a program-run cell invokes its program against. One result row per input.
Names a formalize cell's `doc-<id>` working branch: the document glossary and the run's recorded proposer draws (D71 §9). Re-using it across runs is what makes a re-run LLM-free.
The enc:ReasoningStructure the cell's last formalization run produced — the artifact's root, and the handle a later run supersedes. Absent until the cell has run.
Optional lexicon:LexiconProfile IRI naming the ordered parse scope for a formalize cell (D65 §4). Absent = the whole chain.

A formalize cell's LAND-ON-RUN flag (D71). Off by default: generation stays decoupled from commitment, so the first thing a run gives you is an artifact to read, not a committed layer. Turning it on records the decision IN THE CELL, so `Run all` reproduces the chain state instead of stopping at 'an artifact was produced'. Loading is idempotent — the artifact is content-addressed, so re-running unchanged prose does not advance the branch.
EigenQL query a chart cell evaluates; the ResultSet is decoded and pivoted according to chart_kind / chart_x_column / chart_y_column / chart_series_column.
The Fluent chart kind to render. One of: grouped-bar, vertical-bar, horizontal-bar, donut, line, area.
Short-name of the RETURN column to use as the chart x-axis (or, for donut charts, the slice label).
Short-name of the RETURN column to use as the chart y-axis (or, for donut charts, the slice value).
Optional short-name of the RETURN column to pivot rows into one series per distinct value. Required for grouped-bar; supported by line/area; ignored by donut and single-series bar charts.
Optional human-readable title displayed above the rendered chart.
